- Build a complete, playable 3D open-world survival game for phones and tablets, blending exploration, gathering, building, survival, and trading.

## Requirements
- Support phone and tablet play with usable touch controls.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Created **Wildbound**, a voxel-style valley game with resource gathering, construction, health and nourishment, a day/night cycle, and a trading post.
